Meet the Stylist

Passion for
Beautiful Hair

Hi, I'm Shauna — a Level 2 qualified hair stylist based at Amour Hair & Beauty in Sheldon, Birmingham. With 3 years of salon experience, I specialise in colour transformations, precision cuts and polished styling that leaves every client feeling their absolute best.

From soft balayage to bold colour changes, I love bringing your hair vision to life.
